notes: ★ FIRST FULL VIDEO DECODE at the new Sinnonhyeon site since k8b_100pct. Antenna at window + manual gain L14/M15/V12 (discovered via systematic gain sweep). 79.5% RS success — almost matches k8b_100pct's 87.3%. Decoded 916 KB H.264 MP4 with 51 IDR frames showing real-time YTN news content (e.g., '이란, 러군기지 보복 공격 / 나무호 II', '나무호 피격 관련성 부인'). All 5 services properly identified in FIC (mYTN, HD mYTN, 4DRIVE, LOTTE Homeshop, YTN EWS). fibquality 100 (perfect, vs k8b_v3's 95-99, k8b_v2's 47-78). This proves the upgraded antenna + window placement + manual gain L14/M15/V12 reaches the SNR threshold for robust video decode WITHOUT an LNA.

environment.antenna: upgraded antenna at window edge (same as k8b_v3)
environment.location: Sinnonhyeon (신논현), Seocho-gu, Seoul — indoor AT WINDOW
environment.key_change_from_k8b_v3: switched from -G 0 (AGC) to manual L14/M15/V12 (optimal point from systematic gain sweep)

gain_sweep_result_summary.method: 25-second test capture per config, measured by RS corrected count from verify_outer_fec.py
gain_sweep_result_summary.insight: Hardware AGC (-G 0) is actually sub-optimal in this RF environment — it pushes mixer to a working level but VGA at default 10 leaves the small-signal regime under-amplified. Manual L14/M15/V12 dedicates LNA+mixer to their max (good NF at antenna), and VGA at 12 (slightly above default 10) gives needed final amplification without saturation. Sensitivity-index modes (-G N) follow a fixed curve that's biased for handheld portable use, not optimal for our marginal-signal indoor case.

live_eti_capture.command: AIRSPY_LNA=14 AIRSPY_MIXER=15 AIRSPY_VGA=12 eti-cmdline-airspy -M 1 -C K8B -D 15 -t 60 -O best.eti -J

video_decode_output.content_observed: real-time YTN news segments including '이란, 러군기지 보복 공격', '나무호 II', '나무호 피격 관련성 부인'
